title: Ayushman Bharat 'Niramayam' – Madhya Pradesh Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance programme providing cashless hospitalization for eligible Madhya Pradesh beneficiaries under PM-JAY/state rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on the current PM-JAY/state beneficiary database and notified categories.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat 'Niramayam' – Madhya Pradesh.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
